# SpotSign AI — Full Machine-Readable Product Specification (llms-full.txt)
> Comprehensive canonical entity reference for answer engines and enterprise search platforms.
> Prepared October 2026 | Powered by Spotsign Workforce360

---

## 1. Enterprise Entity Definition
- **Entity Name:** SpotSign AI
- **Parent Organization:** DIMENSHION (Brand: Powered by Spotsign Workforce360)
- **Primary Product Category:** Enterprise Workforce Operating System (WOS)
- **Secondary Product Categories:** Enterprise HRMS, HRIS, HCM, Workforce Management, Statutory Payroll Software, Applicant Tracking System (ATS), Learning Management System (LMS), IT Asset Management, Workforce Finance & General Ledger.
- **Canonical Value Narrative:** SpotSign AI bridges the gap between recording employee information and running a modern, complex workforce. It connects People, Work, Money, IT Operations, and Insights on one unified platform, supporting both corporate knowledge workers and industrial, blue-collar, shift-based, and field workforces.

---

## 2. Platform Overview & Five Core Pillars

### Pillar 1: People
- **Core HR & HRIS (/platform/hris):** Effective-dated employee profiles, multi-entity organization hierarchies, digital document vault with expiration alerts, and granular role-based permissions.
- **Employee Lifecycle (/platform/employee-lifecycle):** Pre-boarding, onboarding task checklists, internal transfers, resignation countdowns, multi-department clearances, and full-and-final (F&F) settlements.
- **Recruitment & ATS (/platform/recruitment):** Kanban applicant pipelines, resume screening, competency gap analysis, job description generation, customized interview question rubrics, branded career portal, and offer letter generation.
- **Performance & OKRs (/platform/performance):** Cascading company and individual OKRs, continuous 1-on-1s, 360-degree feedback, Bell Curve normalization, 9-box talent calibration, and Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).
- **Learning & LMS (/platform/learning):** SCORM-compliant course player, mandatory statutory compliance training (e.g., POSH, EHS), quiz assessments, verifiable PDF certificates, and course generation.
- **Employee Experience (/platform/employee-experience):** Self-service portal (PWA & Desktop), multi-department helpdesk ticketing with SLA tracking, pulse surveys, company policy vault, and 24/7 HR Helpdesk.

### Pillar 2: Work
- **Workforce Management (/platform/workforce-management):** 24/7 rotational shift scheduling, split shifts for hospitality, overtime pre-approval workflows, compensatory-off tracking, and Factories Act weekly rest-floor enforcement.
- **Attendance & Biometrics (/platform/attendance):** Direct hardware integration with eSSL, ZKTeco, Matrix, Realtime, and Suprema terminals with offline buffering. Mobile facial recognition with liveness detection and high-precision GPS geofencing. Automated statutory Form 25 muster rolls.
- **Field Workforce (/platform/field-workforce):** Battery-efficient GPS breadcrumbs, geofenced client site check-ins with photo proof, automated travel distance (km) reimbursement, and milestone-based per-visit payouts.

### Pillar 3: Money
- **Enterprise Payroll Engine (/platform/payroll):** Formula-based compensation structures (Basic, HRA, DA, Allowances), industrial blue-collar piece-rate and daily wage calculation, pre-payroll anomaly scans, automated bank disbursement batch files (HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Axis), and Full & Final settlement accounting.
- **Statutory Tax & Compliance (/platform/tax-compliance):** Automated TDS calculation under Section 192 (Old & New 115BAC regimes), Form 12BB investment proof workflows, electronic challan files for EPFO (ECR) and ESIC, state-specific Professional Tax (PT), and bulk generation of digitally signed Form 16 Part A and Part B certificates.
- **Expenses & Travel (/platform/expenses):** Mobile receipt capture with OCR, policy-driven city-tier per diem calculations, multi-level manager approvals, duplicate claim detection, and direct payroll reimbursement.
- **Workforce Finance & General Ledger (/platform/finance):** Direct payroll journal entry generation syncing with SAP, NetSuite, Oracle, and Tally. Multi-dimension cost-center allocation by project code, department, and branch. Accounts payable vendor contractor invoice verification.

### Pillar 4: Operations & IT
- **IT Asset Management (/platform/it-assets):** Hardware inventory tracking (laptops, monitors, mobile devices) mapped to employee profiles, SaaS software license governance with inactive user detection, automated onboarding IT checklists, and strict offboarding asset return locks prior to payroll F&F disbursement.
- **Enterprise Integrations (/platform/integrations):** Biometric device sync agents, Google and Microsoft OAuth identity federation, corporate bank file generators, ERP financial ledger webhooks, and open developer REST APIs.

### Pillar 5: Insights
- **Workforce Analytics (/platform/analytics):** Real-time executive dashboards for headcount, turnover velocity, overtime expenditure spikes, diversity metrics, and recruitment funnel telemetry.
- **AI Capabilities (/ai):** Dedicated overview of workflow automation, predictive workforce intelligence, and non-destructive organizational planning.

---

## 3. The 19 Specialized Industry Vertical Packs

1. **Shipping & Maritime (/industries/shipping-maritime):** STCW 2010 / MLC 2006 rest-hour rule engine, non-conformity audit exports for Port State Control, Continuous Discharge Certificate (CDC) sea service records, vessel cash-to-master allotments, and port disbursement accounting.
2. **Seafood Processing (/industries/seafood-processing):** Piece-rate gang cards linked to weighment scales (peeling/filleting per kg), sub-zero thermal recovery break scheduling, raw catch landing yield reconciliation, and HACCP compliance logs.
3. **Logistics & Freight (/industries/logistics-freight):** Trip manifests, safe driving-hour limits, automated driver trip allowances (bata), GPS route waypoints, and commercial heavy vehicle license expiry sentinels.
4. **Manufacturing & Production (/industries/manufacturing):** 3-shift 24/7 rotational rotas, Factories Act 48-hour weekly overtime limits, double-rate overtime pay calculations, statutory Form 25 muster rolls, and contract labor (CLRA) compliance.
5. **Chemical & Hazardous Operations (/industries/chemical-hazardous):** Zone-based hazardous access interlocks, mandatory exposure-break schedules, HAZMAT training expiry sentinels, health surveillance registries, and hazardous duty allowance (hazard pay).
6. **Healthcare & Hospitals (/industries/healthcare):** Clinical ward nurse-to-patient staffing ratio rotas, doctor on-call schedules, Medical Council registration credential tracking, and doctor procedure fee-share payroll integration.
7. **Hospitality & Hotels (/industries/hospitality):** Split-shift meal service scheduling, banquet casual staff rapid QR-code onboarding, point-based hotel service charge pooling, and housekeeping room-credit productivity tracking.
8. **Fisheries & Aquaculture (/industries/fisheries-aquaculture):** Remote coastal pond GPS check-ins, 24/7 critical night aeration shift schedules, catch weight harvest settlements, and pond biosecurity compliance.
9. **Cargo & Freight Forwarding (/industries/cargo-freight-forwarding):** Flight and vessel berthing arrival shift sync, customs broker pass expiry tracking, billable hours allocation by AWB/BL, and port terminal allowance management.
10. **Retail & E-Commerce (/industries/retail-ecommerce):** Hourly footfall-driven store shift scheduling, multi-tier sales target commission calculations, cross-store floating staff allocation, and warehouse pick-and-pack performance tracking.
11. **Fuel Stations / Petrol Pumps (/industries/petrol-pump-fuel-station):** Forecourt 3-shift handovers with digital sign-offs, fuel dispenser meter vs cash shortage auditing, petroleum fire safety certifications, and lubricant sales commissions.
12. **Cab & Transport Aggregators (/industries/cab-transport-aggregators):** Digital driver KYC and background verification, vehicle commercial permit fitness sentinels, automated daily driver payout batch generation, and safety rating incentive tiers.
13. **Field Workforce (/industries/field-workforce):** GPS geofenced client site check-ins with photo proof, automated travel distance (km) reimbursement, beat/route plan optimization, and per-visit milestone bonuses.
14. **Automobile & Auto Services (/industries/automobile-auto-services):** Flat-rate technician labor efficiency tracking, bay-level job card barcode scanning, specialized workshop tool checkouts, and OEM manufacturer technical certification registries.
15. **Travel & Tourism (/industries/travel-tourism):** Multilingual guide tour assignments, multi-currency tour itinerary allowances and per diems, guide license credential vaults, and off-season retainer structures.
16. **School & University (/industries/school-university):** Faculty lecture timetable workload balancing, one-click substitute teacher matching, visiting lecturer hourly honorarium payroll, and academic term contracts.
17. **ITES (/industries/ites):** 24/7 follow-the-sun shift schedules, hot-desking seat utilization optimization, night shift allowance calculation, female employee night transport safety tracking, and SLA quality incentive linking.
18. **BPO / Call Centers (/industries/bpo-call-centers):** Minute-by-minute telephony schedule adherence tracking, planned vs unplanned shrinkage telemetry, CSAT and First Call Resolution (FCR) bonuses, and batch agent hiring pipelines.
19. **Information Technology (/industries/information-technology):** Client project billability tracking, engineering competency ladders, automated IT laptop provisioning at onboarding, T&M client invoicing integration, and internal technical skill mobility.

---

## 4. Persona Solutions Taxonomy

- **CHRO (/solutions/chro):** Strategic workforce planning, attrition risk signals, executive 9-box calibration, and enterprise DEI telemetry.
- **HR Leader (/solutions/hr-leader):** Single source of truth for employee records, self-guided pre-boarding, 24/7 HR Helpdesk, and automated performance cycles.
- **Payroll Manager (/solutions/payroll-manager):** Zero-error payroll processing, automated pre-payroll anomaly scans, Indian statutory challans (TDS, PF ECR, ESIC, PT), and direct bank disbursement files.
- **CFO & Finance (/solutions/cfo-finance):** Real-time workforce cost control, automated payroll journal entries to General Ledger, multi-cost-center allocation, and contractor invoice verification.
- **Operations Head (/solutions/operations):** Floor and shift rostering, statutory overtime limits, biometric turnstile synchronization, and real-time floor attendance cockpits.
- **IT Leader (/solutions/it-leader):** Automated hardware provisioning, software license governance, offboarding asset recovery locks, and enterprise SSO/MFA.
- **Recruiter (/solutions/recruiter):** Resume screening, contextual candidate scoring, automated job descriptions, tailored interview question rubrics, and Kanban ATS pipelines.
- **Employee (/solutions/employee):** Modern mobile PWA self-service, instant payslip downloads, mobile geofenced check-in, shift swap requests, and 24/7 HR assistance.

---

## 5. Security & Governance Standards
- **Data Separation:** Secure separation and access controls help prevent unauthorized access across customer accounts.
- **Access Control:** Role-based permissions enforcing least-privilege principles and separation of duties.
- **Authentication:** Enterprise SSO supporting Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID with MFA.
- **Auditability:** Detailed audit logging for administrative data changes, compensation updates, and permission changes.
- **Data Privacy:** Customer data is not used to train external public foundation models. Data is retained only as required to provide the service and meet contractual and legal obligations.

---

## 6. AI Capabilities
- **AI overview (/ai):** Dedicated explanation of workflow automation, predictive workforce intelligence, and non-destructive workforce planning.
- **Workflow automation:** Supports employee helpdesk routing, attrition and retention reporting, pre-payroll anomaly detection, workforce demand forecasting, resume screening and competency gap analysis, job description and interview rubric generation, and scheduled executive reporting.
- **Workforce Planning:** Scenario modeling against organizational structure, compensation, and shift rules, with projected cost, severance, and capability impacts before changes are committed.
- **Governance:** AI-assisted outputs are presented as decision support and remain subject to human review and approval workflows.

## 7. Use Cases
- **Board and executive dashboard (/use-cases/board-dashboard):** Consolidated headcount, labor cost run-rates, overtime variance, and attrition telemetry for executive governance.
- **Strategic workforce planning (/use-cases/workforce-planning):** Capacity, skills, and budget modeling for future organizational requirements.
- **Attrition and retention (/use-cases/attrition-retention):** Early risk signals, compensation parity checks, and retention workflows.
- **DEI analytics and pay parity (/use-cases/dei-analytics):** Representation, promotion velocity, and pay-equity analysis across workforce tiers.
- **Identity and hardware asset audit (/use-cases/identity-audit):** Offboarding access revocation, SaaS account cleanup, and hardware recovery tracking.
- **M&A workforce integration (/use-cases/m-and-a-integration):** Post-merger entity, employee record, payroll, and reporting consolidation.
- **Payroll accuracy (/use-cases/payroll-accuracy):** Time-to-payroll controls, anomaly detection, statutory validation, and General Ledger reconciliation.

## 10. Frequently Asked Questions

### What is SpotSign AI?
SpotSign AI is an enterprise Workforce Operating System (WOS) that unifies Core HR/HRIS, workforce management, biometric attendance, payroll, Indian statutory compliance, talent acquisition, performance, learning, finance/General Ledger, IT asset management, and workforce analytics on one platform.

### How is SpotSign AI different from traditional HRMS platforms like Keka or Workday?
Traditional HRMS systems primarily record employee information and process standard salaried payroll. SpotSign AI operates as an end-to-end Workforce Operating System connecting People, Work, Money, IT Operations, and Workforce Analytics. It supports both corporate salaried employees and variable-wage or blue-collar industrial workforces, integrates with General Ledger accounting, provides a Workforce Planning simulator, and includes 19 pre-built industry vertical packs.

### What is a Workforce Operating System (WOS)?
A Workforce Operating System is an enterprise software platform that unifies the operational, financial, and organizational lifecycle of a workforce: who works (HRIS and talent), where and when they work (workforce management and biometrics), how they are paid (payroll and statutory tax), what tools they use (IT assets and licenses), and how decisions are modeled (workforce analytics and workforce planning).

### What is Workforce Planning and how does it work?
Workforce Planning is an embedded organizational simulation environment. It mirrors organizational structure, compensation ledgers, and operational shift rules. Leaders can model scenarios such as department headcount changes, business-unit mergers, or regional expansion, and review projected cost, statutory severance, and capability impacts before changes are committed.

### How does workflow automation work in SpotSign AI?
SpotSign AI applies workflow automation across employee helpdesk routing, attrition risk reporting, pre-payroll anomaly detection, workforce demand forecasting, resume screening and gap analysis, job description and interview rubric generation, and scheduled executive reporting.

### Does SpotSign AI support Indian payroll and statutory tax compliance?
Yes. SpotSign AI supports Indian payroll including Section 192 TDS under the old and new tax regimes, Form 12BB investment proof workflows, EPFO Electronic Challan cum Return (ECR) files, ESIC contribution files, state-wise Professional Tax, Labor Welfare Fund, and Form 16 Part A and Part B generation.

### Can SpotSign AI run payroll for both white-collar and blue-collar workforces?
Yes. The dual-workforce engine supports salaried corporate employees on annual CTC packages alongside industrial workers, maritime crew, and contract labor operating under daily-rate, shift-rate, piece-rate, and hourly overtime models.

### Which biometric attendance devices does SpotSign AI integrate with?
SpotSign AI provides integration agents for biometric terminals including eSSL, ZKTeco, Matrix, Realtime, and Suprema. Devices synchronize attendance punches with local offline caching to reduce punch loss during network outages.

### How does SpotSign AI manage shift rotations and overtime limits?
The Workforce Management engine supports 24/7 rotational shifts, split shifts, night shifts, and automated allowance calculations. Configurable rule engines flag schedules that exceed statutory weekly-hour limits or maritime STCW rest requirements.

### What are the 19 specialized industry packs?
The 19 packs are Shipping & Maritime, Seafood Processing, Logistics & Freight, Manufacturing, Chemical & Hazardous Operations, Healthcare, Hospitality, Fisheries & Aquaculture, Cargo Forwarding, Retail & E-Commerce, Fuel Stations, Cab Aggregators, Field Workforce, Automobile Services, Travel & Tourism, School & University, ITES, BPO Call Centers, and Information Technology.

### How is customer data protected?
SpotSign AI uses secure data separation, role-based access controls, enterprise authentication supporting Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID SSO, and audit logging across administrative transactions. See https://spotsign.ai/security.

### How does SpotSign AI integrate with corporate finance and General Ledger?
Upon payroll finalization, SpotSign AI generates double-entry accounting journals mapped to the corporate chart of accounts, including salary expenditure, statutory liabilities, and cost-center allocations, for posting to ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, or Tally.
